caption:
How to turn a voice note into a to-do list with AI

Your best ideas show up while you're driving. By the time you're parked, half of them are gone.

Just talk instead: use the mic on your phone keyboard to dictate into your notes app. Don't tidy it up. Then paste it with this:

"Turn this voice note into a to-do list. Group by Today, This week, Someday. One line per task, starting with a verb. Keep dates and names. Ignore the waffle. Voice note: [PASTE]"

I tried it on an example ramble from a plumber: a callback, an invoice, an inspection to book, fittings to order before Thursday and a someday idea. Every task came out as one clean line, in the right group.

Tip: say names and dates out loud. It can only pull out what you said. Skip private details like customer addresses.

Send this to someone who still writes to-dos on their hand. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.

Save this for later. 📌
